title: Changelog fragments, merged into CHANGELOG.md on a changelog-unreleased branch
body:
> Pull requests conflict over `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Changelog Entry

### Changed

- 👷🏻 Changelog entries are now one file per pull request in `.changelog/`, merged into `CHANGELOG.md` on the [`changelog-unreleased`](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/blob/changelog-unreleased/CHANGELOG.md#unreleased) branch, in PR [#5934](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5934), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)

## Description

Each PR adds `.changelog/<PR#>-<slug>.md` instead of editing `CHANGELOG.md`. On every push to `main`, a workflow force-pushes `changelog-unreleased`: `main` + 1 commit that merges the fragments into `[Unreleased]` and deletes them, or `main` if there are none. Squash-merging a copy of it back moves the entries to `main`.

## Design

- No migration: existing `[Unreleased]` entries stay, new ones are appended in merge order.
- The check passes for: own fragment (or `no-changelog`) with `[Unreleased]` unchanged; a merge-back equal to the base plus the fragments it deletes, nothing else; or the `changelog-edit` label (release, typo fixes).
- Merge-backs come from a pushed copy, because bot pushes do not run required checks.

Commit 2 puts issue links first in 13 entries, and the Carousel entry follows the new Added format: `git diff --word-diff 952dae434~1 952dae434 -- CHANGELOG.md`.

Real CI run on `test-changelog-v2-*` (test PRs #5936–#5941: fragments consumed into [one commit on top of the base](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/commit/08d9496bc), merge-back from a copy and directly, hand edit rejected): [`CHANGELOG.md` as rebuilt](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/blob/test-changelog-v2-unreleased/CHANGELOG.md#unreleased).

Questions:

- Added with issues: `Added #5743, …`, or keep `Carousel: added …, fixes #5743`?
- Branch name `changelog-unreleased`?
- Dev-only PRs: `no-changelog` label, or always a 👷🏻 entry?
- Open PRs that edit `[Unreleased]` fail the check, move to a fragment on rebase?
- This PR edits `[Unreleased]` itself, so it needs `changelog-edit` once. OK?

Admins: please create the `changelog-edit` label before merging (this PR needs it). After merge, please make the "Changelog" check required, and do not protect `changelog-unreleased` against force pushes.

## Specific Changes

- `scripts/changelog/*.mjs` with specs, 2 workflows
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `.changelog/README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, PR template

- [x] I have added tests and executed them locally
- [x] I have added `.changelog/<PR#>-<slug>.md`
- [x] I have updated documentation

## Review Checklist

> This section is for contributors to review your work.

- [ ] Accessibility reviewed (tab order, content readability, alt text, color contrast)
- [ ] Browser and platform compatibilities reviewed
- [ ] CSS styles reviewed (minimal rules, no `z-index`)
- [ ] Documents reviewed (docs, samples, live demo)
- [ ] Internationalization reviewed (strings, unit formatting)
- [ ] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` reviewed
- [ ] Security reviewed (no data URIs, check for nonce leak)
- [ ] Tests reviewed (coverage, legitimacy)
